title: GOOD MORNING, JASMINE & SKYLAR!
script:
GOOD MORNING, JASMINE & SKYLAR!

Genre: Preschool Musical / Educational Nursery Rhyme
Duration: 96 seconds
Format: 16 shots x variable 4–8 seconds
Aspect ratio: 9:16

Character consistency

JASMINE: Older sister, approximately 6 years old, warm brown skin, large expressive brown eyes, round childlike face, long dark-brown curly hair styled in two high curly ponytails with pink bows. She is confident, cheerful, patient, and often leads the activities. She begins the episode wearing pink pajamas with tiny white flower prints and matching pink slippers. After getting dressed, she wears a bright pink short-sleeved dress with small white flowers, white ankle socks, and pink shoes.

SKYLAR: Younger sister, approximately 4 years old, warm brown skin, large expressive brown eyes, slightly smaller round childlike face, dark-brown curly hair styled in two fluffy puff ponytails with purple bows. She is playful, curious, funny, and occasionally gives deliberately silly answers. She begins the episode wearing lavender pajamas with small heart prints and purple slippers. After getting dressed, she wears a lavender-purple short-sleeved dress with small heart details, white ankle socks, and purple shoes.

SUNNY: Small friendly animated yellow sun with large eyes, rosy cheeks, tiny arms, and a cheerful smile. Appears outside the bedroom window and occasionally reacts to Jasmine and Skylar.

Visual style: High-quality colorful 3D preschool animation, soft rounded shapes, bright pastel colors, expressive faces, gentle cinematic lighting, polished children's television quality, safe and cheerful atmosphere. Jasmine and Skylar must maintain exactly the same facial identity, hairstyle, proportions, skin tone, and clothing within each continuity phase.

Location: A cheerful family home beginning in Jasmine and Skylar's shared pastel bedroom, continuing into the connected children's bathroom, then returning to the bedroom. The bedroom has two small beds, rainbow bedding, a large sunny window, soft toys, colorful storage cubes, a round rug, and a small wardrobe. Morning sunlight remains warm and consistent. The bathroom has two child-height sinks, a large mirror, pastel towels, two toothbrush cups, and bright natural morning light. Props introduced in one shot must remain in the correct location unless visibly moved.

SHOT 1 - SUNSHINE WAKE-UP

Scene: BEDROOM WAKE-UP
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:00-00:06
Framing: Wide establishing shot

Action:
Warm morning sunlight enters the colorful bedroom. Jasmine sleeps in the left bed while Skylar sleeps in the right bed hugging a small cream teddy bear. Outside the window, Sunny slowly rises into view and smiles.

SUNNY:
"Good morning!"

Sound: Gentle birds chirping, soft sparkling chime, quiet upbeat nursery-music introduction, Sunny's cheerful voice.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 high-quality 3D preschool animation starting frame inside a bright pastel children's bedroom at sunrise. Jasmine, the older sister with warm brown skin and two dark-brown curly ponytails with pink bows, sleeps in the left bed wearing pink flower-print pajamas. Skylar, the smaller younger sister with warm brown skin and two fluffy dark-brown puff ponytails with purple bows, sleeps in the right bed wearing lavender heart-print pajamas while hugging a cream teddy bear. Large sunny window behind them, smiling animated yellow sun just beginning to appear outside, rainbow bedding, colorful toy shelves, round rug, warm golden morning light, clean child-friendly environment. Preserve exact character identities and proportions. No text, no watermark, no extra children.

Video prompt:
Sunny slowly rises outside the window while soft sunlight gradually brightens the bedroom. Curtains move gently in the morning breeze. Jasmine and Skylar remain asleep with subtle breathing motion. Sunny smiles, raises one tiny hand, and lip-syncs "Good morning!" Camera makes a very slow gentle push toward the beds. Preserve Jasmine and Skylar's exact identities, pajamas, hairstyles, teddy bear position, bedroom layout, and warm sunrise lighting.

SHOT 2 - JASMINE SAYS HELLO

Scene: BEDROOM WAKE-UP
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:06-00:12
Framing: Medium shot on Jasmine

Action:
Jasmine opens her eyes, sits upright, stretches both arms high, then smiles directly toward the viewer.

JASMINE:
"Good morning, little stars! Can you say good morning?"

Sound: Birds continue outside, soft playful xylophone melody, Jasmine's clear warm child voice.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 high-quality 3D preschool animation starting frame focused on Jasmine lying asleep in her left bedroom bed. Jasmine has warm brown skin, large brown eyes, dark-brown curly hair in two ponytails with pink bows, pink flower-print pajamas, pink slippers visible beside the bed. Her eyes are closed and both arms rest on the bedding; she has not yet sat up or stretched. Skylar remains sleeping softly out of focus in the background with her cream teddy bear. Same colorful bedroom, same warm sunrise lighting, same window and props. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Jasmine opens her eyes fully, sits upright, stretches both arms high, lowers them, then turns toward camera with a bright welcoming smile. She lip-syncs naturally to "Good morning, little stars! Can you say good morning?" Hold a short inviting pause at the end as though waiting for children to respond. Slight slow camera push-in. Skylar remains asleep in the background. Preserve all character features and bedroom continuity.

SHOT 3 - SKYlar POPS UP

Scene: BEDROOM WAKE-UP
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:12-00:18
Framing: Medium two-shot

Action:
After a short response pause, Skylar suddenly pops up from beneath her blanket with the teddy bear beside her. Jasmine turns toward her and laughs.

JASMINE:
"Good morning, Skylar!"

Sound: Playful pop sound as Skylar sits up, children's giggle sound, upbeat music becoming slightly livelier.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 colorful 3D preschool animation starting frame showing Jasmine sitting happily on her left bed while Skylar is still mostly beneath the lavender blanket on the right bed, moments before popping upright. Jasmine wears pink flower pajamas with pink hair bows. Skylar wears lavender heart pajamas with purple bows, cream teddy bear beside her pillow. Warm sunrise bedroom lighting, toys and rainbow decorations unchanged, polished toddler-show style. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Skylar suddenly pops upright from beneath her blanket with a huge playful smile, raising both hands. She enthusiastically lip-syncs "GOOD MORNING!" Jasmine turns toward Skylar, laughs gently, and lip-syncs "Good morning, Skylar!" Skylar's teddy bear bounces slightly from the movement but remains on the bed. Camera stays stable with a tiny playful push-in. Preserve exact identities and bedroom continuity. After the greeting, both girls step out of their beds, put on their established slippers, and meet side by side on the rug. Leave the teddy beside Skylar's pillow. End standing on the rug with arms lowered.

SHOT 4 - WAKE UP YOUR HANDS

Scene: MORNING SONG
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:18-00:24
Framing: Full-body two-shot

Action:
Jasmine and Skylar stand together on the bedroom rug. Jasmine begins the morning song and both wave their hands above their heads.

JASMINE:
"Good morning, sunshine, good morning, sky!"

Sound: Bright original nursery-rhyme instrumental with ukulele, bells, handclaps, and light percussion. Singing clearly synchronized. Jasmine leads the vocal; Skylar joins in unison. Shared lyrics occur once, without repeating the line.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 high-quality 3D preschool animation starting frame. Jasmine and Skylar stand side by side on the round colorful bedroom rug in their same pajamas and slippers. Jasmine is taller on the left in pink flower pajamas and pink bows. Skylar is smaller on the right in lavender heart pajamas and purple bows. Both begin with their arms lowered. Sunny smiles through the window behind them. Same beds, toys, wardrobe, warm morning light. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Jasmine and Skylar raise both arms and wave their hands rhythmically while singing "Good morning, sunshine, good morning, sky!" Their faces remain joyful and expressive. Sunny outside gently sways to the music. Camera makes a subtle side-to-side floating motion synchronized with the beat. Maintain exact pajamas, hair bows, body proportions, lighting, and bedroom layout. End with both arms lowered, ready to clap.

SHOT 5 - CLAP, TAP, STRETCH

Scene: MORNING SONG
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:24-00:30
Framing: Full-body front shot

Action:
The girls perform three simple actions: clap twice, tap their feet twice, then stretch high.

JASMINE:
"Clap, clap!"

SKYLAR:
"Tap, tap!"

JASMINE:
"Stretch up high!"

Sound: Two clear handclaps, two soft foot taps, upbeat nursery music, playful rising whistle during the stretch. Jasmine leads the vocal; Skylar joins in unison. Shared lyrics occur once, without repeating the line.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 polished 3D preschool animation starting frame of Jasmine and Skylar standing on the same bedroom rug facing camera, hands positioned just apart moments before clapping. Jasmine remains in pink pajamas and Skylar in lavender pajamas. Sunny visible through window, bedroom props unchanged, bright cheerful morning lighting, safe toddler-friendly composition. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Jasmine and Skylar clap twice together. Jasmine lip-syncs "Clap, clap!" Skylar then taps both feet twice while saying "Tap, tap!" Both raise their arms high and rise onto their toes while singing "Stretch up high!" Skylar stretches slightly too far and wobbles comically, then regains balance while smiling. Camera remains front-facing with gentle rhythmic bounce. Preserve identity and continuity.

SHOT 6 - WHAT IS THIS?

Scene: BATHROOM BRUSHING
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:30-00:36
Framing: Medium two-shot at sink

Action:
In the bathroom, Jasmine holds up a small pink toothbrush while Skylar stands beside her holding nothing. Both face the viewer.

JASMINE:
"What is this?"

Sound: Music softens underneath dialogue, tiny magical ping when the toothbrush is raised, light bathroom ambience.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 high-quality 3D preschool animation starting frame inside a bright pastel children's bathroom. Jasmine stands at the left child-height sink wearing the same pink flower pajamas, holding a pink toothbrush at chest height and preparing to lift it. Skylar stands beside her at the right sink in the same lavender heart pajamas, watching curiously. Pink toothbrush cup beside Jasmine, purple toothbrush cup beside Skylar, large clean mirror, pastel towels, warm natural morning light. No toothpaste yet on brushes. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Jasmine slowly raises the pink toothbrush toward camera, tilts her head inquisitively, and lip-syncs "What is this?" Both girls then look toward the viewer and hold a brief response pause. Skylar's eyes move curiously between the toothbrush and camera. Slight camera push toward the toothbrush without changing spatial continuity.

SHOT 7 - TOOTHBRUSH!

Scene: BATHROOM BRUSHING
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:36-00:42
Framing: Close two-shot

Action:
Skylar excitedly points at Jasmine's toothbrush, then picks up her own purple toothbrush from the cup. Jasmine takes a small toothpaste tube from beside her cup, applies a small dab to each brush, and returns the tube beside her cup.

SKYLAR:
"A toothbrush!"

JASMINE:
"That's right!"

Sound: Happy bell, cheerful musical flourish, light giggle.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 3D preschool animation starting frame in the same bathroom. Jasmine holds the pink toothbrush clearly near her shoulder. Skylar stands beside the purple toothbrush cup with her right hand beginning to reach toward her purple toothbrush. Both wear unchanged pajamas and hairstyles. Same mirror, sinks, towels, and morning lighting. No text, no watermark. A small toothpaste tube rests beside the pink cup.

Video prompt:
Skylar points excitedly toward Jasmine's toothbrush and lip-syncs "A toothbrush!" She then reaches into her purple cup and lifts her own toothbrush. Jasmine nods proudly and says "That's right!" A tiny sparkle flashes beside both toothbrushes. Keep camera at child eye level and preserve exact bathroom layout and identities. After the answer, Jasmine visibly takes the toothpaste tube from beside her pink cup, applies a small dab to each toothbrush while Skylar holds hers steady, and returns the tube. End with both brushes prepared and held away from their mouths.

SHOT 8 - BRUSHING SONG

Scene: BATHROOM BRUSHING
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:42-00:48
Framing: Medium mirror-facing two-shot

Action:
Both girls brush their teeth with gentle circular motions while watching themselves in the mirror.

JASMINE:
"Brush, brush, brush your teeth, make them nice and clean!"

Sound: Nursery-rhyme backing music, Jasmine and Skylar singing the lyric together as voiceover, gentle brushing and rinsing sounds.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 colorful 3D preschool animation starting frame in the same bathroom. Jasmine at left holds her pink toothbrush with a small amount of white toothpaste already applied. Skylar at right holds her purple toothbrush with toothpaste applied. Both are positioned at their correct sinks, ready to begin brushing. Their pajamas, hair bows, mirror, towels, toothbrush cups, and morning lighting remain unchanged. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Both girls brush gently using circular motions while swaying slightly. The lyric "Brush, brush, brush your teeth, make them nice and clean!" plays as a musical voiceover led by Jasmine with Skylar joining; do not attempt speaking around toothbrushes. Mirror reflections follow their movement. Foam appears only after brushing begins. They then finish, rinse, and visibly return the pink brush to the pink cup and purple brush to the purple cup. Turn on the faucets and end with Jasmine cupping water beneath hers, ready for the next shot. Keep exact identities, pajamas and bathroom geography.

SHOT 9 - WASH, WASH, SPLASH

Scene: BATHROOM WASH-UP
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:48-00:54
Framing: Medium two-shot

Action:
The toothbrushes are returned to their matching cups. Jasmine gently splashes water onto her cheeks. Skylar copies her and creates a slightly bigger playful splash.

JASMINE:
"Wash, wash!"

SKYLAR:
"Splish, splash!"

Sound: Running water, two playful splash effects, happy music continuing quietly.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 3D preschool animation starting frame inside the same bathroom. Pink toothbrush is now back in Jasmine's pink cup and purple toothbrush is back in Skylar's purple cup. Jasmine leans toward her sink with clean wet hands cupped beneath the faucet. Skylar stands at her sink watching Jasmine and preparing to copy her. Same pajamas, hairstyles, towels, mirror, and lighting. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Jasmine lifts a small amount of water and gently splashes her cheeks while saying "Wash, wash!" Skylar copies her but makes a slightly larger harmless splash and cheerfully says "Splish, splash!" Jasmine laughs. Small water droplets sparkle briefly in the light. Keep water movement realistic and minimal. Camera stays medium and stable. After the splash, both dry their faces with their respective pastel towels and return the towels to their hooks. Jasmine retrieves the rinsed pink toothbrush, carries it toward the bedroom, and places it on the bedside ledge near Skylar's bed. The purple brush remains in its cup.

SHOT 10 - TIME TO GET DRESSED

Scene: BEDROOM DRESS-UP
Time of day: Morning
Time: 00:54-01:00
Framing: Wide symmetrical shot

Action:
Back in the bedroom, Jasmine stands beside a pink dress hanging from the wardrobe while Skylar stands beside a purple dress. Each girl grabs her outfit and spins toward camera.

JASMINE:
"Let's get dressed!"

SKYLAR:
"Spin!"

Sound: Quick magical transition music, wardrobe door creak, playful twinkle.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 high-quality 3D preschool animation starting frame back in the same bedroom. Jasmine in pink flower pajamas stands left beside the open wardrobe standing beside a hanging bright pink short-sleeved dress with tiny white flowers. Skylar in lavender heart pajamas stands right standing beside a hanging lavender-purple short-sleeved dress with small heart details. Their matching white socks and shoes are neatly placed below. Beds and toys remain in previous positions, morning sunlight slightly brighter than earlier. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Begin in the exact frame. Jasmine and Skylar visibly take their hanging dresses from the wardrobe. Jasmine says "Let's get dressed!" Skylar says "Spin!" Both spin once as a gentle opaque sparkle transition covers their outfits. End with both wearing their established day dresses, white socks and matching shoes, standing with hands lowered and no loose garments held. Preserve faces, hairstyles, proportions and room layout.

SHOT 11 - TA-DA!

Scene: BEDROOM DRESS-UP
Time of day: Morning
Time: 01:00-01:06
Framing: Full-body hero two-shot

Action:
The spin finishes. Jasmine is now wearing her pink day dress, socks, and shoes. Skylar is wearing her purple day dress, socks, and shoes. They pose proudly and high-five.

SKYLAR:
"Ta-da!"

JASMINE:
"We're ready!"

Sound: Magical sparkle finish, high-five clap, upbeat musical flourish.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 bright polished 3D preschool animation starting frame at the end of the dress-up transition. Jasmine, exact same face and hairstyle, now wears a pink short-sleeved dress with small white flowers, white ankle socks, and pink shoes. Skylar, exact same face and hairstyle, now wears a lavender-purple short-sleeved dress with small heart details, white ankle socks, and purple shoes. Both stand on the bedroom rug with hands lowered; the sparkle transition has just finished. Pajamas are no longer being worn. Same bedroom and bright morning lighting. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
The girls begin already dressed and standing still after the completed spin. Skylar throws her arms outward and lip-syncs "Ta-da!" Jasmine smiles and says "We're ready!" They turn toward each other and complete one cheerful high-five. Keep their new outfits unchanged for every remaining shot. After the high-five, Jasmine retrieves the pink toothbrush from the bedside ledge and the teddy from beside Skylar's pillow, carrying the brush in her left hand and teddy in her right. She sets both on the nearby toy shelf before joining Skylar on the rug.

SHOT 12 - ONE, TWO, THREE!

Scene: COUNTING GAME
Time of day: Morning
Time: 01:06-01:12
Framing: Full-body front shot

Action:
Jasmine raises one finger, Skylar raises two, and together they prepare to jump three times.

JASMINE:
"Let's jump three times!"

JASMINE:
"One! Two! Three!"

Sound: Three rhythmic drum beats, children's voices counting, upbeat nursery track. Jasmine leads the vocal; Skylar joins in unison. Shared lyrics occur once, without repeating the line.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 3D preschool animation starting frame of Jasmine and Skylar standing side by side on the bedroom rug in their day outfits. Jasmine wears pink dress and pink shoes; Skylar wears purple dress and purple shoes. Jasmine raises one finger toward camera while Skylar watches excitedly. Sunny remains smiling through the window. Toys and furniture remain fixed. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Jasmine says "Let's jump three times!" Both bend their knees slightly. They perform exactly three small safe jumps, calling "One!" on the first jump, "Two!" on the second, and "Three!" on the highest final jump. Camera makes a subtle upward motion with the final jump, then settles. Preserve clothing and identity exactly. End with both safely landed. Jasmine then retrieves the toothbrush from the toy shelf into her left hand and the teddy into her right hand; Skylar watches. Finish facing the viewer with those exact props held.

SHOT 13 - TEDDY OR TOOTHBRUSH?

Scene: SILLY QUIZ
Time of day: Morning
Time: 01:12-01:18
Framing: Medium three-object composition

Action:
Jasmine holds the pink toothbrush in one hand and Skylar's cream teddy bear in the other. Skylar looks between them thoughtfully.

JASMINE:
"Which one do we use to brush our teeth?"

Sound: Music becomes playful and quiet, soft ticking sound during the answer pause.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 high-quality 3D preschool animation starting frame in the bedroom. Jasmine stands left in her pink day dress holding the familiar pink toothbrush in her left hand and Skylar's cream teddy bear in her right hand, both clearly visible and separated. Skylar stands right in her purple day dress looking thoughtfully at the two objects. Same bedroom, bright morning light, clean composition emphasizing toothbrush and teddy. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Jasmine alternates slightly raising the toothbrush and teddy bear while asking "Which one do we use to brush our teeth?" Both girls then look directly toward the viewer and wait for an answer. A soft playful ticking sound emphasizes the pause. Keep props clearly visible and camera nearly static.

SHOT 14 - SKYlar'S SILLY ANSWER

Scene: SILLY QUIZ
Time of day: Morning
Time: 01:18-01:24
Framing: Medium two-shot

Action:
Skylar confidently points at the teddy bear. Jasmine makes a playful surprised expression. Skylar then laughs and points to the toothbrush.

SKYLAR:
"The teddy bear?"

JASMINE:
"Noooo!"

SKYLAR:
"The toothbrush!"

Sound: Gentle comedy buzzer after teddy-bear answer, children's laughter, bright success bell after toothbrush answer.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 polished 3D preschool animation starting frame continuing directly from the previous shot. Jasmine still holds the pink toothbrush and cream teddy bear in the same hands. Skylar, wearing purple day dress, begins pointing toward the teddy bear with a mischievous confident smile. Jasmine wears pink dress and watches her. Same lighting, positions, props, and bedroom. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Skylar points dramatically toward the teddy bear and lip-syncs "The teddy bear?" A gentle silly buzzer sounds. Jasmine widens her eyes, smiles, and says "Noooo!" Skylar giggles, quickly switches her pointing finger toward the toothbrush, and says "The toothbrush!" A happy bell rings. Jasmine nods enthusiastically. Preserve exact prop hands and spatial continuity.

SHOT 15 - GOOD MORNING DANCE

Scene: FINALE
Time of day: Morning
Time: 01:24-01:32
Framing: Wide celebratory two-shot

Action:
Jasmine places the toothbrush and teddy on the toy shelf, joins Skylar, and both clap, tap, and turn once while singing together. They finish facing the viewer with arms lowered.

JASMINE:
"Clap your hands, tap your feet! Good morning, everyone we meet!"

Sound: Full cheerful nursery-rhyme finale, handclaps, light foot taps, sparkling chimes, children's laughter, final musical logo sting. Jasmine leads the vocal; Skylar joins in unison. Shared lyrics occur once, without repeating the line.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 polished 3D preschool animation starting frame continuing directly from the previous shot. Jasmine still holds the pink toothbrush and cream teddy bear in the same hands. Skylar stands with hands lowered beside Jasmine. Jasmine wears pink dress and watches her. Same lighting, positions, props, and bedroom. No text, no watermark.

Video prompt:
Jasmine begins holding the pink toothbrush in her left hand and the cream teddy in her right. She visibly places both on the nearby toy shelf, then joins Skylar on the rug. Both clap twice, tap twice, and perform one gentle turn while singing "Clap your hands, tap your feet! Good morning, everyone we meet!" Jasmine leads and Skylar joins in unison. End facing camera with hands lowered. Sunny smiles outside. Preserve day outfits, identity and prop locations.

SHOT 16 - GOODBYE, LITTLE STARS

Scene: FINALE
Time of day: Morning
Time: 01:32-01:36
Framing: Wide two-shot

Action:
Both girls wave to the viewer. Sunny waves outside. The toothbrush and teddy remain on the toy shelf.

JASMINE:
"Bye, little stars!"

SKYLAR:
"Bye-bye!"

Sound: Soft cheerful musical ending, sparkling chimes, final logo sting.

Image prompt:
Vertical 9:16 polished colorful 3D preschool animation. Jasmine in her established pink flower day dress and Skylar in her purple heart day dress stand facing the camera on the same bedroom rug with arms lowered, ready to wave. Exact faces, hairstyles, socks and shoes. Pink toothbrush and cream teddy remain on the toy shelf. Sunny smiles outside the same window. Warm morning light. No extra characters, no text, no watermark.

Camera gently pulls back. End smiling and waving, then fade out. Keep the toothbrush and teddy on the shelf and preserve identities, day outfits and room layout.
